parallel_evidence.scope: Actual Newton/MuJoCoWarp CUDA simultaneous identical-scene/command worlds; all-world q/v/equality/time, existing contact metrics and raw physical break events checked against N1.
resource_caveats: CPU/RSS samples cover owned process tree during loop, sampled every ~5s; CPU100% denotes one logical CPU, not all host cores.
GPU usage/memory is sampled whole-device including desktop/other retained clients; it is not a per-process allocation or continuous peak.
Controller resource samples additionally include lock waits/setup/saving and should not replace executor loop samples.
limitations: Different scenes and independently varied commands were not qualified by this identical-replica campaign.
Per-environment rate decreases as N increases; aggregate throughput is a separate measure.
Contact-phase realtime is not established by total average RTF.

batched_cusolver_n1_comparison.decision: Valid N1 but 6.9% slower than native Warp N1; conditional N4 not executed under the pilot budget. N>1 batched cuSOLVER throughput remains unmeasured. Different floating-point grouping; exact trajectory equivalence is not claimed.
